description: Meta-STT engine that runs multiple OVOS STT plugins in parallel and merges their hypotheses with ROVER word-level alignment and majority voting; accuracy improves most when backends have different error characteristics.
notes: Backends per the README configuration example, with each backend model pinned: openai/whisper-small.en (from the whisper plugin's documented model list) and vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 (from the vosk plugin's documented model URL).
